title: 'The Trump plan changed nothing': One year later, Gaza still lives in ruins, under bombs
subhead: Three years after the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, residents of the Palestinian territory continue to live among rubble. The plan brokered under the auspices of the American president on October 10, 2025 has stalled, and despite the ceasefire it provides for, Israel's campaign of destruction has continued.

title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay for her efforts to promote international law
subhead: Pillay, 85, is a former UN human rights commissioner. The Nobel jury said it was honoring her for her 'commitment to universal legal principles and her firm moral compass.'

subhead: The court rejected the US sanctions as an attack on international law and warned in a statement that 'history will judge this moment.'

title: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
subhead: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.
